evidence: MITgcm at lunar gravity on one-degree cells under one repeated model year of the fresh-sea climate's fluxes; a first run from a uniform start, with no tide and with closure constants fitted on Earth. Not validated against any observation.
reading_rule: months are means over a twelfth of the forcing's year for the top 5 m; areas in km2 by salinity class in g/kg (fresh under 0.5, nearly fresh to 5, brackish to 18, mixed to 30, diluted sea water to 34, sea water to 36, saltier above). old_water_share is the dye: the share of the water below a depth that has not been at the surface since the start, as each model year's mean; years also give the dye, the salinity and the temperature at each level (level_mid_m) over the model's own open cells, the top layer's temperature by band of true latitude, the depth from which the water stands at or under the eels' warm limit, and the water at the eels' depth. Water below about 500 m still holds the run's starting temperature in its first decades. oxygen_estimate is a reading of the dye, not a tracer the model carries: on each level of the sea taken as the lake model's basin, saturation at the coldest band's surface less the demand over the renewal rate the dye shows across its last years, for the sea oxygen study's central column of each nutrient state, with that demand as the lake model sets it in depth and as an ocean's sinking flux would (martin_b). deep_flow_m_s gives the speeds of the latest yearly mean at four depths.
